usage: icebath webapp [-h] [--no-open] [--force-build] [--skip-build] [--build-only | --status |
                      --sign-out]

Open the Icebath Desktop workspace in a browser. The gateway serves it when webapp.enabled is true
in config.yaml; this command builds the bundle when needed, starts the gateway and opens a one-use
sign-in link.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --no-open      Print the one-use link instead of opening a browser
  --force-build  Rebuild the Webapp bundle even when its build receipt is current
  --skip-build   Use the existing Webapp bundle as is
  --build-only   Build the Webapp bundle and stop
  --status       Show whether the gateway is serving the Webapp
  --sign-out     Sign out every Webapp tab (each needs a new link from icebath webapp)
